policy: Build or deploy a new behavior only when its stated outcome has a measurable benefit over a recorded baseline.

entries.hypothesis: The upstream R2 default-processor heading control path may produce observed forward displacement, unlike the completed secondary-processor heading attempt.

baseline.summary: The secondary-processor/tripod path completed safely with no observed locomotion.

measurement.collection: Supervising operator observes direction, displacement, and final stance after one bounded pulse.

entries.decision_rule: A positive observed displacement establishes only a candidate drive path for further calibrated stop testing; no displacement closes this stock-heading variation without retry.
entries.result: Two separately authorized default-primary heading pulses completed with the watchdog safe hold, and the supervising operator confirmed locomotion.
entries.next_action: Measure one conservative, bounded calibration segment and its stopped final state before claiming distance, speed, or physical-stop effectiveness.

entries.hypothesis: The verified stock/default-primary heading path can produce one conservatively bounded forward segment that an operator can measure, establishing a calibration baseline without exceeding the Phase 1 0.25 m limit.

baseline.summary: The stock/default-primary heading diagnostic produced operator-observed locomotion, but the distance and stopping effectiveness remain unmeasured.

measurement.collection: A supervising operator measures the forward displacement from fixed start and finish marks, observes direction, final stance, and stationary state after the independent watchdog safe hold.

entries.decision_rule: A measured segment within the 0.25 m bound establishes only a preliminary motion calibration datum; unexpected direction, excessive distance, or any abnormal behavior stops the branch and leaves physical-stop effectiveness unverified.
entries.result: On 8-inch carpet tiles, the repeated stock/default-primary speed-25, 0.10-second pulse produced a measured straight forward displacement of 3 inches (0.0762 m), within the 0.25 m limit; watchdog safe hold and normal two-leg return were observed.
entries.next_action: Treat this as carpet-tile-only calibration. Measure physical stopping distance and response separately before asserting stop effectiveness or applying any value to another surface.

entries.hypothesis: For the measured 0.0762 m carpet-tile calibration segment, the independent OFF/0 watchdog leaves R2 stationary within the marked 0.25 m containment boundary and produces a normal final stance.

baseline.summary: The current calibration proves only a queued, unacknowledged stop and a final stationary observation; it does not measure stopping distance or prove physical-stop effectiveness.

measurement.collection: On 8-inch carpet tiles, the supervising operator measures the center-to-center final position relative to the 0.0762 m calibration mark and confirms that R2 is stationary in a 0.25 m contained lane after the independently queued OFF/0 watchdog.

entries.decision_rule: A measured final position no farther than 0.25 m from the marked start and a normal stationary final state provide one surface-specific physical-stop observation; any overrun, abnormal behavior, or inability to measure closes the branch without a parameter retry.
entries.result: On 8-inch carpet tiles, the marked-lane run ended 2.75 inches (0.06985 m) from the center start mark, inside the 0.25 m containment boundary. This is 0.00635 m shorter than the prior 3-inch calibration datum; the watchdog safe hold and normal final stance were observed.
entries.next_action: Record this as one carpet-tile-only physical-stop observation. Do not generalize it to another surface; next address the remaining actual-firmware capability report and untested telemetry controls.

entries.hypothesis: A stationary post-connect head-position query can establish whether the R201 responds to a read-only head capability while also recording its advertised telemetry inventory, without drive or expressive commands.

baseline.summary: The former head-position query timed out before the wake/connect sequence was understood, and telemetry remains unverified on the actual firmware.

measurement.collection: One separately authorized stationary probe records the sanitized head-query result, advertised telemetry stream names, connection lifecycle, and final safe-hold state; no drive, heading, leg, LED, audio, or animation option is enabled.

entries.decision_rule: A read result or a sanitized, stable failure phase advances the capability report; no movement command is permitted and the run is not retried unchanged.
entries.result: The read-only head query timed out at the stable head.safe_range phase. The driver ended disconnected/offline and stopped, with movement_performed false; this unchanged probe path is closed.
entries.next_action: Import the sanitized failure record and preserve head.position_read as untested/failed-to-characterize. Investigate a distinct non-blocking packet trace only if it offers a measurable distinction from the completed synchronous query.

entries.hypothesis: Selecting the R2 secondary processor and explicit tripod stance will produce observed forward wheel motion where earlier primary/default-path attempts did not.

baseline.summary: Four prior bounded forward pulses and one R2 generic-drive attempt produced no observed locomotion.

measurement.collection: Supervising operator observes direction and measured displacement after the single bounded pulse.

entries.result: LEDs and the three-leg to two-leg stance cycle were observed; no locomotion was observed.
entries.decision_rule: No observed displacement means this path is not a validated wheel-control path and must not be retried unchanged.
entries.next_action: Compare the exact encoded stock high-level control path with the reviewed diagnostic packet path without accessing hardware.

entries.hypothesis: A static, byte-level comparison can identify a control-path difference between the current diagnostic and the upstream recommended high-level R2 path, producing a distinct testable hypothesis before any new hardware action.

baseline.summary: Current secondary-processor diagnostic completes safely but produces no observed locomotion.

measurement.collection: Deterministic static comparison of reviewed upstream/library source and locally encoded test fixtures; no BLE import, scan, connection, or write.

entries.decision_rule: Build a new diagnostic only if the comparison finds at least one reviewed, R2-applicable difference and a simulation test captures it; otherwise close the locomotion branch pending new external evidence.
entries.result: The pinned upstream R2 binding retains proc=None for stock raw-motor and heading calls, while the completed diagnostic explicitly used Processors.SECONDARY; deterministic audit found two control-path differences without hardware access.
entries.next_action: Do not schedule another HIL run until a distinct, documented hypothesis explains why the stock primary/default control path would improve on its prior no-motion result.

entries.hypothesis: Replacing the closed direct head query and obsolete low-volume/short-dwell expression settings with the already verified session-initialized head path and 255-volume, 3.5-second audio envelope will complete one observed stationary proof-of-life expression.

baseline.summary: The previous proof-of-life HIL failed before expression_started; direct head read was subsequently characterized as unsuitable, while the separate session-initialized head and audio preview paths are verified.

measurement.collection: One separately authorized, watchdog-bounded run records durable stages and immutable evidence; the supervising operator confirms audible sound, bounded dome movement, LEDs, final stationary state, and no locomotion.

entries.decision_rule: A completed report plus matching operator observation establishes only this exact stationary proof-of-life composition; any failure or unexpected motion closes the run without an automatic retry.
entries.result: The watchdog-bounded run completed all durable stages. The supervising operator observed the two-leg to three-leg to two-leg wake cycle, dome reset then left/right/center sweep, LED flashes, an audible greeting-like vocalization, a short stationary pause, and final LEDs off; no locomotion was observed.
entries.next_action: Record the immutable HIL report and operator observation as the completed stationary proof-of-life evidence; keep all future expressions separately authorized.
